description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): current stablecoin depeg flags (USDT, USDC, DAI, USDe, FDUSD, PYUSD) and recent exploit clusters from the Legion Go headline tagger. Returns a peg snapshot plus events with severity (info/warn/high/critical), cluster_id and sources. Default drops exploit_followup (legal/recovery coverage) unless include_followups=true. Optional filters: type, min_severity, asset, since. Bad params 400, missing or stale (>2h) data 503; no charge on errors. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/depeg-exploit

asset.description: Optional ticker filter, e.g. FDUSD or BTC; also matches detail.assets and stablecoins_mentioned

include_followups.description: If true, include exploit_followup events (default false)

min_severity.description: Optional minimum severity (info < warn < high < critical)

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp; keep events whose last_seen is on or after this time

type.description: Optional event type filter. type=exploit_followup also includes follow-ups.

name: get_depeg_exploit_alerts

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired (what this MCP tool returns, isError=true)

items.description: [{id, event_type, asset, severity, first_seen, last_seen, headline, detail, sources, cluster_id?}]

title: Depeg and exploit alerts (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
